digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output and retry system
propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduling in `_pai_structured` with a single bounded Agent operation composing S1 adapter `pai_output.output_function` as `output_type=TextOutput(fn)`, preserving full history and shared request budget.

Implement wire-context projection via pydantic-ai `history_processors` that omits failed ModelResponse only when full request plus output reserve fits the model context window, while keeping `all_messages()` complete and raising `ContextWindowExceededError` on authoritative-input overflow.

Add concision-aware guard on PROMPTED branch only that detects truncation (`length`/`max_tokens` finish reason) and issues bounded `ModelRetry` with concision instruction, while keeping NativeOutput branch terminal via unmodified `pai_output.guard_capability()`.

Compute combined request budget once as base (`ceil(eff_max_iter/2)`) plus output-retry allowance (`structured.OUTPUT_RETRIES` minus `req.structured_retry_limit`), with no per-attempt reset and shared counter for both concision and parse/validation retries.
Preserve NativeOutput selection, bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback, and terminal truncation handling while replacing only the manual for-loop with the bounded operation.
